```{r load libraries}
library(biomaRt)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(clusterProfiler)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r read the files}
mnn <- read.csv("/path_to_folder/grp3_vs_grp1_mnn_sig.csv")

```

```{r choose ensemble version}
listEnsembl() 

ensembl <- useEnsembl(biomart = "genes")
datasets <- listDatasets(ensembl)

Ensemble <- useDataset(dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl", mart = ensembl)
ensemble <- useEnsembl('ensembl', mirror = 'useast')

attr <- listAttributes(Ensemble)
Ensemble <- useEnsembl(biomart="genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

```

```{r up- and downregulated genes in select cell cluster}
#upregulated
mnn.top <- mnn[mnn$log2FoldChange > 0.5,]
mnn.top <- mnn.top[order(mnn.top$log2FoldChange, decreasing = TRUE),]

Ensemble_ID_mnn <- getBM(mart = Ensemble, attributes = c('external_gene_name', 'ensembl_gene_id'), 
                         filters = "external_gene_name",
                         values = mnn.top$X
)

col3 <- Ensemble_ID_mnn$ensembl_gene_id
GO_results3 <- enrichGO(gene = col3, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "ENSEMBL", ont = "BP")

edox3 <- setReadable(GO_results3, 'org.Hs.eg.db', 'ENSEMBL')
head(edox3)
fit3 <- plot(barplot(edox3, showCategory =10))
write.csv(edox3, file = "/path_to_folder/copd_vs_ns_MNN_up_GOanalyses.csv")

#Downregulated
mnn.down <- mnn[mnn$log2FoldChange < -0.5,]
mnn.down <- mnn.down[order(mnn.down$log2FoldChange, decreasing = FALSE),]

Ensemble_ID_mnn_down <- getBM(mart = Ensemble, attributes = c('external_gene_name', 'ensembl_gene_id'), 
                              filters = "external_gene_name",
                              values = mnn.down$X
)

col4 <- Ensemble_ID_mnn_down$ensembl_gene_id
GO_results4 <- enrichGO(gene = col4, OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "ENSEMBL", ont = "BP")

edox4 <- setReadable(GO_results4, 'org.Hs.eg.db', 'ENSEMBL')
head(edox4)
fit4 <- plot(barplot(edox4, showCategory =10))
write.csv(edox4, file = "/path_to_folder/copd_vs_ns_MNN_down_GOanalyses.csv")

```
